note: Synthetic career samples for the demo people (data/demo/personas.json) and the career tests. Every person, employer and announcement is invented; announcements are marked SYNTHETIC ANNOUNCEMENT FOR DEMONSTRATION. Jordan's nursing case reproduces the specification's highest-value fixture (a legally required licence, a record of its absence, acronyms, a hyphenated specialty and a card that just says 'Current.').

dana.objective: Operations leader ready to run transportation and dispatch teams

announcement.title: Transportation Operations Supervisor
announcement.raw:
SYNTHETIC ANNOUNCEMENT FOR DEMONSTRATION
Transportation Operations Supervisor

ABOUT THE POSITION
Supervises a district dispatch and fleet section.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
- Two years of experience supervising transportation, dispatch or fleet operations
- Valid Class A commercial driver's license
- High school diploma or GED

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES
- Knowledge of route planning and dispatch systems
- Ability to maintain accurate vehicle maintenance records

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience with fleet management software
- Coursework in business or logistics

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS
- Copy of driver's license and DD-214 Member 4

HOW TO APPLY
Apply through the state jobs portal.

marcus.objective: Systems administrator ready to support federal network operations

announcement.title: IT Specialist (SYSADMIN) GS-2210-11
announcement.raw:
SYNTHETIC ANNOUNCEMENT FOR DEMONSTRATION
IT Specialist (SYSADMIN) GS-2210-11

DUTIES
Administers servers and directory services for a regional office.

SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE
One year of specialized experience equivalent to GS-09 administering Windows and Linux servers,
managing Active Directory accounts and applying security configuration baselines such as STIGs to
networked systems.

QUALIFICATIONS
- Security+ certification or another 8570 baseline certification within six months of appointment
- Must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance

PREFERRED
- Experience leading a team of technicians

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS
- Resume, transcripts if qualifying on education, DD-214 Member 4

EDUCATION SUBSTITUTION
A master's degree in a related field may substitute for specialized experience.

evidence.title: Information Systems Technician (IT1), U.S. Navy
evidence.summary: Administered Windows and Linux servers and the command network. Managed Active Directory accounts and group policy. Applied STIG baselines and patched networked systems monthly. Led a team of technicians on watch rotations.

metrics.phrase: Administered servers and the network for {v} users.

evidence.title: IT Support Specialist
evidence.summary: Resolve help desk tickets for a regional office. Maintain Active Directory accounts and workstation images.

evidence.title: Security clearance
evidence.summary: A clearance was mentioned during intake. Level, adjudication date and current status are not recorded.

evidence.title: B.S. Information Technology (in progress)
evidence.summary: Enrolled in an online information technology degree program.
